description: Source file implementing the FilterSourceStream class for handling data filtering and decompression in the net namespace, including methods for reading, filtering, and parsing encoding types.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class that manages data filtering and decompression from an upstream source, supporting various encoding types and asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous read operation, setting up buffers and states.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the current stream, including upstream description.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if the stream may have more data to read.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Parses a string encoding to determine the corresponding encoding type enum.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Executes the state machine loop for reading and filtering data.

methods.name: DoReadData
methods.description: Performs a read operation from the upstream source.

methods.name: DoReadDataComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of the read operation, updating buffers and state.

methods.name: DoFilterData
methods.description: Filters or decompresses data in the buffer.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an asynchronous IO operation completes.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Checks if more data is needed from upstream.
